events.what: Durban International Film Festival 2027 early submission deadline: 23 November 2026; category eligibility applies
events.effect: Organiser lists African feature and documentary entries and short and student films worldwide; non-African feature films are solicited by the festival.

events.what: Durban International Film Festival 2027 regular submission deadline: 15 January; category and South African premiere rules apply
events.effect: The organiser requires eligible films completed after 1 January 2026 and states a South African premiere requirement.

events.what: Durban International Film Festival: 15 to 25 July; check screening programme and access
events.effect: Festival for audiences and filmmakers; a film submission does not provide participation or entry rights.
